abilities.desc_zh: 近战增益
abilities.desc_en: Melee Buff

abilities.desc_zh: 势不可挡
abilities.desc_en: Unstoppable

abilities.desc_zh: 烧伤
abilities.desc_en: Burn

abilities.desc_zh: 被动：
abilities.desc_en: Passive:

abilities.title_en: The bot’s naturally tough Cybertronian exterior permanently provides {{var_1}} passive Armor.
abilities.desc_zh: 该机器人天然坚韧的塞伯坦外观永久提供 {{var_1}} 被动装甲。
abilities.desc_en: The bot’s naturally tough Cybertronian exterior permanently provides {{var_1}} passive Armor.

abilities.title_en: Tantrum gains an additional {{var_2}} passive Armor while Dashing forward.
abilities.desc_zh: 发脾气在向前冲刺时获得额外的 {{var_2}} 被动装甲。
abilities.desc_en: Tantrum gains an additional {{var_2}} passive Armor while Dashing forward.

abilities.desc_zh: 冲刺和闪避：
abilities.desc_en: Dashing and Dodging:

abilities.title_en: Dashing towards the opponent has a {{var_3}} Chance to grant a Melee Buff, increasing Melee Damage by {{var_4}}. [Max 10 stacks]
abilities.desc_zh: 冲向对手有 {{var_3}} 几率获得近战增益，使近战伤害增加 {{var_4}}。 [最多10层]
abilities.desc_en: Dashing towards the opponent has a {{var_3}} Chance to grant a Melee Buff, increasing Melee Damage by {{var_4}}. [Max 10 stacks]

abilities.title_en: If Tantrum Dodges backwards he loses all Melee Buffs.
abilities.desc_zh: 如果发脾气向后闪避，他会失去所有近战增益。
abilities.desc_en: If Tantrum Dodges backwards he loses all Melee Buffs.

abilities.desc_zh: 重击：
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Attacks:

abilities.title_en: {{var_5}} Chance for each Melee Buff on Tantrum to Stun the opponent for {{var_6}}.
abilities.desc_zh: {{var_5}} 发脾气时每个近战增益都有机会击晕对手以获得 {{var_6}}。
abilities.desc_en: {{var_5}} Chance for each Melee Buff on Tantrum to Stun the opponent for {{var_6}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 封锁：
abilities.desc_en: Blocking:

abilities.title_en: Holding Block allows Tantrum to Charge an Unstoppable Buff. After Charging for {{var_7}}, Tantrum becomes Unstoppable for {{var_8}}seconds and does not lose Melee Buffs when Dodging backwards.
abilities.desc_zh: 保持格挡可以让发脾气冲出不可阻挡的增益。冲锋 {{var_7}} 后，发脾气会变得不可阻挡 {{var_8}} 秒，并且向后躲避时不会失去近战增益。
abilities.desc_en: Holding Block allows Tantrum to Charge an Unstoppable Buff. After Charging for {{var_7}}, Tantrum becomes Unstoppable for {{var_8}}seconds and does not lose Melee Buffs when Dodging backwards.

abilities.title_en: Charging Unstoppable is {{var_9}} faster for each Melee Buff on Tantrum.
abilities.desc_zh: 发脾气时每增加一个近战增益，“势不可挡”的冲锋速度就会加快 {{var_9}}。
abilities.desc_en: Charging Unstoppable is {{var_9}} faster for each Melee Buff on Tantrum.

abilities.title_en: Once Unstoppable expires Tantrum must Cool Off and cannot recharge his Unstoppable for {{var_10}}.
abilities.desc_zh: 一旦不可阻挡到期，发脾气必须冷静下来，并且无法为 {{var_10}} 为他的不可阻挡充电。
abilities.desc_en: Once Unstoppable expires Tantrum must Cool Off and cannot recharge his Unstoppable for {{var_10}}.

abilities.title_zh: 疯狂：发脾气的攻击变得狂野且不可预测，突破敌人的防御并无视他们的破坏性减益效果。
abilities.title_en: Frenzy: Tantrum’s attacks become wild and unpredictable, punching through enemy defenses and ignoring their damaging debuffs.
abilities.desc_zh: 每 3 个近战奖励增益：当发脾气获得 3 个近战奖励增益时，他会获得狂乱，从而获得 +{{var_11}} 暴击率和 {{var_12}} 几率为 {{var_13}} 提供不可阻挡的机会。此外，当发脾气变得疯狂时，他会净化所有伤害性减益效果，并且在疯狂期间不会受到进一步的伤害性减益效果。
abilities.desc_en:
Frenzy: Tantrum’s attacks become wild and unpredictable, punching through enemy defenses and ignoring their damaging debuffs.
Every 3 Melee Bonus Buffs: When Tantrum gains 3 Melee Bonus Buffs he gains Frenzy, granting +{{var_11}} Critical Chance and a {{var_12}} chance to be Unblockable for {{var_13}}. Additionally, when Tantrum becomes Frenzied, he Purifies all Damaging Debuffs and cannot be inflicted with further Damaging Debuffs for the duration of Frenzy.

abilities.desc_zh: 发脾气总是头脑发热。
abilities.desc_en: Special 1 – Flamethrower - Tantrum is always hot headed.

abilities.desc_zh: 发脾气时每个近战增益有 {{var_14}} 几率造成灼伤，造成热伤害，伤害值等于 {{var_15}} 的攻击评级高于 {{var_16}}。
abilities.desc_en: {{var_14}} chance for each Melee Buff on Tantrum to inflict Burn, dealing heat damage equal to {{var_15}} of Attack Rating over {{var_16}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 剑 - 准备好受到冲击力的震动。
abilities.desc_en: Special 2 – Electro-Sword - Prepare to be jolted by the impact.
Allies – Galvatron, Cyclonus - +{{var_20}}~{{var_21}} Armor.
– Enemies – Blaster, Arcee - +{{var_22}}~{{var_23}} Attack Rating.

abilities.title_zh: 兽祖 – 全兽战机器人
abilities.title_en: Beast Ancestor – All Beast War Bots
abilities.desc_zh: 每次重击后，该机器人都会获得野兽之怒增益，使攻击有 {{var_24}}~{{var_25}} 机会无法被 {{var_26}} 阻挡。
abilities.desc_en: Beast Ancestor – All Beast War Bots - After each Heavy Attack, this bot gains a Beast Fury buff that grants Attacks a {{var_24}}~{{var_25}} chance to be Unblockable for {{var_26}}.
